name: print-social-creative-company-instagram-pack-navy-yellow-grid-texture
title: 'Creative Company' Instagram pack on navy with a grainy grid texture, yellow arrows and colour-block logo squares
whatItIs: Nine navy square posts with a subtle grain and grid texture, yellow corner arrows, a small colour-block logo mark (red, yellow, cream squares), bold headlines ('Creative Company', 'Join Us!', 'Bold Design for Bold Ideas'), and orange pill tags listing services (Graphic Design, Layout & Advertising, Social Media, Photography).
whatItMeans: Confident and textured; grain and grid patterns give a flat navy-yellow palette real depth and studio credibility.
techniques: Add fine grain and grid texture to a flat colour background.
Use a small colour-block grid as a compact logo mark.
Mark corners with directional arrow icons for energy.

vocabulary.definition: A fine noise pattern added for depth and warmth.
A logo built from small solid-colour squares.
